questions.stem: The graph of $y = 2f(x)$ compared to $y = f(x)$ is:

options.text: Stretched vertically by a factor of $2$
Stretched horizontally by a factor of $2$
Compressed vertically by a factor of $2$

questions.explanation: Multiplying $f(x)$ by $2$ doubles every $y$-value, which stretches the graph vertically by a scale factor of $2$.
